description: Header file defining the ProgramGL class interface for OpenGL rendering in the ANGLE project, including methods for shader program management, uniform setting, and rendering path configuration.

classes.name: ProgramGL
classes.description: Class representing an OpenGL shader program with methods for linking, validation, uniform management, and rendering path control.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a shader program from a binary stream.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the shader program to a binary stream.

methods.name: setBinaryRetrievableHint
methods.description: Sets whether the program binary can be retrieved.

methods.name: setSeparable
methods.description: Sets whether the program is separable.

methods.name: link
methods.description: Links the shader program with specified resources.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the program against the current GL context capabilities.

methods.name: setUniform1fv
methods.description: Sets a float uniform vector of size 1.

methods.name: setUniform2fv
methods.description: Sets a float uniform vector of size 2.

methods.name: setUniform3fv
methods.description: Sets a float uniform vector of size 3.

methods.name: setUniform4fv
methods.description: Sets a float uniform vector of size 4.

methods.name: setUniform1iv
methods.description: Sets an integer uniform vector of size 1.

methods.name: setUniform2iv
methods.description: Sets an integer uniform vector of size 2.

methods.name: setUniform3iv
methods.description: Sets an integer uniform vector of size 3.

methods.name: setUniform4iv
methods.description: Sets an integer uniform vector of size 4.

methods.name: setUniform1uiv
methods.description: Sets an unsigned integer uniform vector of size 1.

methods.name: setUniform2uiv
methods.description: Sets an unsigned integer uniform vector of size 2.

methods.name: setUniform3uiv
methods.description: Sets an unsigned integer uniform vector of size 3.

methods.name: setUniform4uiv
methods.description: Sets an unsigned integer uniform vector of size 4.

methods.name: setUniformMatrix2fv
methods.description: Sets a 2x2 float matrix uniform.

methods.name: setUniformMatrix3fv
methods.description: Sets a 3x3 float matrix uniform.

methods.name: setUniformMatrix4fv
methods.description: Sets a 4x4 float matrix uniform.

methods.name: setUniformMatrix2x3fv
methods.description: Sets a 2x3 float matrix uniform.

methods.name: setUniformMatrix3x2fv
methods.description: Sets a 3x2 float matrix uniform.

methods.name: setUniformMatrix2x4fv
methods.description: Sets a 2x4 float matrix uniform.

methods.name: setUniformMatrix4x2fv
methods.description: Sets a 4x2 float matrix uniform.

methods.name: setUniformMatrix3x4fv
methods.description: Sets a 3x4 float matrix uniform.

methods.name: setUniformMatrix4x3fv
methods.description: Sets a 4x3 float matrix uniform.

methods.name: getUniformfv
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a float uniform.

methods.name: getUniformiv
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an integer uniform.

methods.name: getUniformuiv
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an unsigned integer uniform.

methods.name: setPathFragmentInputGen
methods.description: Configures path fragment input generation.

methods.name: markUnusedUniformLocations
methods.description: Marks certain uniform locations as unused.

methods.name: getProgramID
methods.description: Returns the OpenGL program ID.

methods.name: enableSideBySideRenderingPath
methods.description: Enables side-by-side rendering path.

methods.name: enableLayeredRenderingPath
methods.description: Enables layered rendering path with a specified base view index.

methods.name: syncState
methods.description: Synchronizes the program state with the GL context.
